prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high (except round 11), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a clear checklist layout highlighting key benefits of adoption paths. (why: Choose path step takes a long mean time (514s), showing users need a clearer structure to decide quickly.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Customization Preview Stage: Insert a new adoption preview screen showing visual generation progress before final certificate confirmation. (why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% with 1017s mean time and users report pet generation issues.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Account Continuity List Redesign: Redesign the sign-in layout into a list format that emphasizes restoring existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel Flow: Add an automated tip carousel flow on the waiting screen to keep users engaged during generation. (why: Waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) causing high user drop-off.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Add a hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing and lighting guidelines. (why: 3 support messages cited custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Progress Notification: Enable visual progress tracking and finish notifications on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s, leading to drop-off without clear progress indicators.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Controls Overview Split Layout: Switch the home intro screen layout to split view detailing taskbar tray management. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to hide, show, or control the pet after setup.)
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro System Tray Instructions Copy: Update home intro screen copy with step-by-step instructions for interacting with desktop pets. (why: Users wrote to support asking how to control or hide the pet once onboarding finishes.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Path Overview Copy Update: Revise story screen text to set clear expectations between standard pets and custom photo pets. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, indicating confusion between available onboarding paths.)
